text: FAA guidance states that when the control link is lost and cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures; if VLOS is temporarily lost, regain VLOS as soon as practicable; there is no fixed VLOS interruption time, and loss-of-VLOS procedures apply. Manuals from Matrice 4T and Matrice 210 V1 describe Failsafe RTH on signal loss, RTH path display when possible, brake/hover or Original Route RTH when vision is unavailable, and backward flight up to 50 m for long RTH; GPS weak signal can prevent return to the Home Point. Incident reports are unverified accounts with no usable evidence.
